sensitivity_screen._note: SCREEN-MODEL-CONFIG — the GOV-3 sensitivity screen (the one live inference call). Primary model + ordered fallbacks; the next fallback is tried once on a retryable provider error (404/429/5xx/timeout). Any other error, or exhaustion, fails CLOSED (held for review). Unreadable config → hardcoded last-resort default in lib/content-sensitivity-llm.js.
